elements.notes: Central Arabic script with full tashkeel (fatha, damma, sukun, shadda). Combining marks must be applied via GPOS mark-to-base/mark-to-mark positioning by a proper shaping engine (e.g. HarfBuzz) or native OS text rendering. Font must include tashkeel glyphs and GPOS tables — Arial and most generic sans fonts will drop or misplace these marks.

encoding_notes: Arabic text_01 content is stored as a single NFC-normalized Unicode string; diacritics (tashkeel) are combining marks that immediately follow their base letter in logical order — do not store or position them as separate elements.

Rendering text_01 correctly requires a shaping engine (HarfBuzz or equivalent OS text stack) to perform Arabic contextual letter-joining and GPOS mark-to-base/mark-to-mark positioning for the diacritics. Glyph-by-glyph rendering without shaping will misplace or drop the shadda, fatha, damma, and sukun marks.
Font choice matters: the font must include tashkeel glyphs and GPOS positioning tables. Arial and most generic UI sans fonts lack this and will render broken or missing diacritics.
